rules.note: A graphic object's colour (logos, frame bars), placed by the source order: map-symbols.md §9.3 'Source order'.
A white the source draws over layers the palette ranks above its role, placed by the source order; the gap that fits the source best does not fit every layer.
Uses with no role, placed by the source order; the gap that fits the source best does not fit every layer.
A pair of roles the source orders against the palette, drawn in the palette's order (dropped by default, or blocked by an order that cannot change): map-symbols.md §9.3 'Deviations'.
Isolated changed pixels no paint image names, not even at 3x: a feature finer than a third of a pixel, or a change at a tile's edge caused just outside it (map-rendering.md §6.5, I4).
